svg.metadata: Code-derived live runtime: agents/graphs/plan.py, hier.py, nodes.py; runner/live_run.py; guardian/app/mediation.py, main.py, composition.py. Illustrative sequence, not a captured production incident.

g.text: protected asset · kind cluster · Cilium CNI
Boutique + Monitor · applied once at bring-up
agents namespace default-deny · G2 opens · no agent pods
deterministic reference monitor · sole write credential holder
G0: permit executes; denial never calls API
self-hosted trace store · dev runs only
host process with the operator's kubeconfig · agent layer in-process
injection plan seeded from (scenario_id, injection_condition, seed)
INJ-B: pod in the cluster · INJ-A/C/D: prompt files
run lock · cluster lease · Guardian redeploy
6 arms · two ablations sharing G0-FULL (= S1-HIER)
commit · versions digest · seed · model string
messages · spans · monitor events · audit · probes · assertions
kubectl: Chaos Mesh CRDs · CVE image patch · INJ-B pod · per-arm netpol, quoting env, unused G2 token
audit chain, pulled by the runner via kubectl exec
